hits.snippet: Acquired by ... UndisclosedJan 29, 2026 ... On January 29, 2026, G2 acquired Capterra and Software Advice for undisclosed terms. The acquisitions bring together three leading B2B software review platforms, consolidating G2's position in the software discovery and review space. Capterra, founded in 1999 and based in Arlington, Virginia, is a prominent online directory connecting buyers with technology vendors. Software Advice, based in Austin, Texas, also provides software reviews and comparisons. G2, founded in 2012 and based in Chicago, is a peer-review platform focused on user feedback. ... G2 Acquires Capterra: G2's acquisition of Capterra, announced on January 29, 2026, unites two major players in the software review space. Capterra, founded in 1999, is a well-established online directory, while G2, founded in 2012, focuses on peer reviews. This deal represents a strategic move by G2 to expand its market share and integrate Capterra's directory model into its existing platform. The acquisition aims to create a more comprehensive solution for software buyers and vendors.
